events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From 'And now for something completely different' to Basil Fawlty's finest moments, what's your favourite Cleese classic?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, marking 58 years since its debut.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. An eclectic masterpiece, but what's your standout track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, would have been 80

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the inimitable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. A voice, a showman, a legend – his legacy continues to rock us.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a pivotal album in their evolution, what track still resonates most with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
